content: The second perfection in the Level Five reading is making-manifest (iẓhār), for which the Seal is the individual capable of the office. The moon is a metaphor for that perfect form, as poets call a perfect form a moon, and the splitting of the moon is a metaphor for the emergence of meaning in its full perfection from that form, bypassing ratiocination and syllogisms; this route was vouchsafed the Seal.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
